t: This is the Guards Crimean War Memorial, a Grade II listed monument on Waterloo Place, at the junction of Regent Street and Pall Mall. It commemorates the Allied victory in the Crimean War of 1853 to 1856. It was made by John Bell, a British sculptor born in 1811. His work was shown at the Great Exhibition of 1851, and he also made the marble group representing America on the Albert Memorial. The memorial sits roughly a quarter of the way from the Duke of York Column towards Piccadilly Circus.
